官方资料核验于 2026 年 9 月 9 日。路线顺序与停留时长为 BAYLIN: Official sources checked on September 9, 2026. Route order and stop durations are BAYLINK editorial suggestions. Recheck prices, opening times, reservations and transport before visiting. Credited reference photos do not show guaranteed conditions, flowers or exhibitions on your travel date.
第一次去 Muir Woods：先订停车，再用短环线走进红木林: Your first Muir Woods visit: reserve arrival, then take a short redwood loop
门票与停车是两笔安排；选 Bridge 2 或 Bridge 3，不必一口气上山: Admission and parking are separate; choose Bridge 2 or Bridge 3 without adding a mountain hike
适合初访者的红木林短程，拆开停车/接驳与门票，说明无信号准备、主步道折返和推车路: A first-visit redwood route covering separate parking/shuttle and admission bookings, offline preparation, short main-trail loops and stroller conditions.
带长辈或孩子的家庭: Families with children or older adults
NPS：Muir Woods 费用与通票: NPS: Muir Woods fees and passes
16 岁及以上普通入园 $15，停车或接驳不包含在门票中。: Standard admission is $15 for ages 16+ and does not include parking or shuttle reservations.
官方授权：停车与接驳预约: Authorized operator: parking and shuttle reservations
查询可订日期、标准车辆停车及接驳票，不在山谷临时找信号下单。: Check dates, standard-vehicle parking and shuttle tickets before reaching the valley without reception.
Bridge 2、3、4 距离不同，上山延伸路不等同主步道。: Bridge 2, 3 and 4 routes differ in length; uphill extensions are not equivalent to the main trail.
主步道部分路面有根系隆起和裂缝，先问当天条件。: Some main-trail surfaces have roots and cracks; ask about current conditions.
红木林最值得看的，是人站在树下突然变小的感觉。Muir Woods 不需要靠长距: The memorable moment in a redwood forest is feeling small beneath the trees. You do not need a long hike for that at Muir Woods: the main trail near the entrance already passes towering coast redwoods. On a first visit, focus on arriving smoothly, slowing down and returning comfortably rather than adding an ambitious uphill trail.
建议给园内留 1.5–2.5 小时，再另算弯曲山路或接驳时间。园区关闭随季节变化: Allow 1.5–2.5 hours inside, plus winding-road or shuttle travel. Closing time changes seasonally; check the day’s notices.
普通入园 16 岁及以上每人 $15，15 岁及以下免费。标准车辆停车预约 $1: Standard admission is $15 per person age 16+, free for ages 15 and under. Standard-vehicle parking reservations cost $10; round-trip shuttle tickets cost $4 for ages 16+, with free child tickets that still require reservations.
所有车辆与接驳乘客都须提前预约；门票或公园通票不代替停车/接驳名额。接驳按可运营: All vehicles and shuttle riders need advance reservations. Admission or a park pass does not reserve parking or a shuttle seat. Plan around available shuttle dates, stops and departures.
用桥的编号选择红木短环线: Choose a short redwood loop by bridge number
把桥当折返点，而不是必须越走越远: Use the bridges to choose your turnaround
停留时长是编辑建议，不含往返交通；按现场开放和同行者体力调整。: Suggested stop durations are editorial estimates and exclude travel to and from the area. Adjust for closures and your group’s energy.
出发前下载预约凭证、地图和返程信息；山谷及周边没有手机信号或 Wi-Fi。到达先: Download reservations, maps and return details before leaving: there is no cell service or Wi-Fi in and around the valley. Ask staff about main-trail access and surfaces to avoid.
主步道到第二座桥的环线约 0.5 英里，官方估约半小时；加上看树与停留可慢慢走更: The loop to Bridge 2 is about 0.5 miles, estimated by NPS at half an hour. Add time for looking and resting, and follow posted directions back to the entrance.
有余力可选约 1 英里的 Bridge 3 环线，官方估一小时。桥 2–3 西侧: If comfortable, choose the roughly 1-mile Bridge 3 loop, estimated at an hour. The west side between bridges 2 and 3 is rougher; ask a ranger about mobility needs and avoid adding Hillside Trail just to complete a loop.
回程比去程更需要提前安排：不要计划出林后才叫车。同行者先约定集合位置和时间，把司: Plan your departure before arrival rather than expecting to request a ride after the walk. Save the meeting point, time, driver or shuttle stop and return plan offline. The main trail mixes boardwalk and paved surfaces, with possible root heave, so strollers and wheelchairs may still encounter obstacles. Keep the path clear for upward-looking photos, stay behind barriers and do not assume picnics are allowed inside the park.
进入无信号山谷前再检查一次: Check everything before entering the valley without reception
停车或接驳已有确认，再核门票或通票资格。: Confirm parking or shuttle reservations, then check admission or pass eligibility.
下载全部凭证与地图，出发前约定返程，带水和保暖层。: Download tickets and maps, arrange the return trip, and bring water and warm layers.
按体力选 Bridge 2 或 3，先问步道状况与闭园时间。: Choose Bridge 2 or 3 for your group’s energy and ask about conditions and closing time.
预约 Muir Woods 停车或接驳: Reserve Muir Woods parking or shuttle
打开官方页面，按实际出行日期核对后再订票或出发。: Check the official page for your travel date before booking or setting out.
把实际体验留给下一位湾区邻居: Share your visit with the next Bay Area neighbor
欢迎分享当天的开放提醒、适合同行者的短路线和一张自己拍的照片；约同行时写明日期、: Share current access notes, a shorter route that worked for your group and a photo you took. When arranging company, include the date, meeting point, transport and expected finish time.
